design.shape: one schedule trigger fanning out to two independent data branches, each ending in a specialist agent, merged into a composer agent, rendered to HTML, delivered by Gmail
agents: Email Triage Agent - sorts the inbox into urgent / needsReply / fyi with counts, structured output
Calendar Planner Agent - turns today events into an ordered day plan with conflicts and free blocks, structured output
Briefing Composer Agent - merges both findings into the dashboard content model, structured output
nodes: Fetch Inbox Since Midnight (gmail 2.2, message:getAll, receivedAfter $today, simple, limit 50)
Email Triage Agent (agent 3.1) + Email Triage Schema (outputParserStructured 1.3)
Fetch Calendar For Today (googleCalendar 1.3, event:getAll, timeMin $today, timeMax $today+1d, singleEvents, orderBy startTime)
Calendar Planner Agent (agent 3.1) + Day Plan Schema (outputParserStructured 1.3)
Combine Agent Findings (merge 3.2, combine / combineByPosition, inputs 0 and 1)
Briefing Composer Agent (agent 3.1) + Dashboard Content Schema (outputParserStructured 1.3)
Briefing Model (lmChatOpenAi 1.3, shared by all three agents)
Deliver Briefing Dashboard (gmail 2.2, message:send, emailType html)
decisions: Two data branches run off the same trigger rather than chained, so the calendar fetch does not run once per email item.
Aggregate before each agent so the agent runs once over the whole bundle instead of once per message.

alwaysOutputData on the two Aggregate nodes only: without it a morning with zero new mail or zero events would skip the merge and no briefing would go out. Prompts read $json.emails ?? [] so the empty case renders as an empty bundle, not a fake item.
One shared language model node feeds all three agents, so the user fills one model credential instead of three.
The HTML node owns the styling and layout; the agent only produces the content model. Deterministic dashboard chrome, no LLM-authored CSS.
Rendered fields run through replace(/[<>]/g, '') and the composer is instructed to emit plain text, so an email subject cannot inject markup into the briefing.
Table-based layout and inline-safe CSS rather than flexbox, since the dashboard is delivered as an HTML email.

credentials.policy: No credential value was ever invented and no credential was created by the builder. Nodes that need auth were declared with newCredential('<name>') per the SDK reference, which leaves the slot empty.
